reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 51 open opportunities (retail material sales, distinct from project work) running its own +3d/+8d automated follow-up cadence; no stale threshold is defined for it per platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json. Data-hygiene note: 17 of those 51 currently sit in the '6a. Closed - Won' (13) or '6b. Closed - Lost' (4) named stages while opportunity.status is still 'open' -- likely a manual stage move that wasn't paired with a formal status close.

method_notes.window: Catch-up window: 2026-08-14T08:45:11-04:00 (last successful ghl ingest per run-ledger.json) through 2026-08-25T08:23:07-04:00 (~264h / 11 days), per orchestrator instruction to widen the normal 24h lookback.
method_notes.conversations_scope: 192 conversations had activity in the window. Full-thread deep-read (entire history, not just last message) was performed for the 23 conversations where we owed a real (non-call) reply, plus the 3 won-deal threads -- these carry the richest contact_notion detail. The remaining 169 (128 already-answered by us, 41 inbound calls with no voicemail) are populated from conversation-list metadata (tags, direction, timing) rather than a full-thread pull, given the volume of this 11-day catch-up vs. a normal ~24h run; missed-call-no-voicemail was verified as a real pattern (list body field is stale/mismatched to the true last message on TYPE_CALL entries) via 2 full-thread spot-checks.
method_notes.followup_not_fired_confidence: The 16 candidates were identified by: mobile-quote tag present, quote sent >=5 days ago, and zero conversation activity anywhere in the 11-day window. This proves no activity in the last 11 days, not conclusively that the ~5-day post-quote follow-up itself never fired (it may have fired and gone unanswered outside the visible window). Treat as a spot-check list, not a confirmed automation failure.
method_notes.opportunity_status_counts_scope: Lifetime totals across all opportunities in each pipeline (from search-opportunity meta.total per status), not limited to the catch-up window.
method_notes.closed_opportunities_scope: won: full lifetime won list per pipeline was pulled and filtered to lastStatusChangeAt within the window (project: 300 lifetime -> 3 in-window; store: 6 lifetime -> 0 in-window; lead-qual pipeline: 1 lifetime -> 0 in-window). lost/abandoned: NOT exhaustively re-scanned for window-closes given volume (231 lost + 1,277 abandoned lifetime across all pipelines); the 3 lost items reported were found via a createdAt>=window-start filter (fast-cycle rejections only), so a lost/abandoned close on an opportunity created before 2026-08-14 would not be surfaced as an item this run. Lifetime status totals above are unaffected by this scoping.
